# Agent

`c.Agent` calls the API's Agent group. Operations related to agent discovery and
details.

### List

```go
func (s *AgentService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[ListAgentsResponse], error)
```

List active agents.

Discover all active agents in the fleet.

It sends `GET /api/agent`, and needs the permission `agent:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List active agents, `go run agent.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Agent.List(ctx)
```

### Facts

```go
func (s *AgentService) Facts(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[FactKeysResponse], error)
```

List the fact keys.

Returns the fact keys that an input can refer to as @fact.<key>: the built-in
keys and the custom keys that agents register.

It sends `GET /api/agent/facts`, and needs the permission `agent:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List the fact keys, `go run agent.go facts`:

```go
resp, err := c.Agent.Facts(ctx)
```

### Get

```go
func (s *AgentService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[AgentInfo], error)
```

Get agent details.

Get detailed information about a specific agent by hostname.

It sends `GET /api/agent/{hostname}`, and needs the permission `agent:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get agent details, `go run agent.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Agent.Get(ctx, "web-01")
```

### Drain

```go
func (s *AgentService) Drain(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) error
```

Drain an agent.

Stop the agent from accepting new jobs. In-flight jobs continue to completion.

It sends `POST /api/agent/{hostname}/drain`, and needs the permission
`agent:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Drain an agent, `go run agent.go drain`:

```go
err := c.Agent.Drain(ctx, "web-01")
```

### Undrain

```go
func (s *AgentService) Undrain(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) error
```

Undrain an agent.

Resume accepting jobs on a drained agent.

It sends `POST /api/agent/{hostname}/undrain`, and needs the permission
`agent:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Undrain an agent, `go run agent.go undrain`:

```go
err := c.Agent.Undrain(ctx, "web-01")
```

### AgentState

The scheduling state of an agent: Ready, Draining, Cordoned or Pending. A drain
that the agent has not applied yet is Draining.

A `string`, one of `Ready`, `Draining`, `Cordoned`, `Pending`.

### ConditionType

A condition that an agent or a component evaluates.

A `string`, one of `MemoryPressure`, `HighLoad`, `DiskPressure`, `DrainStuck`,
`ConsumersUnavailable`, `ProcessMemoryPressure`, `ProcessHighCPU`.
